verses.original: Ταύτας οὖν ἔχοντες τὰς ἐπαγγελίας ἀγαπητοί καθαρίσωμεν ἑαυτοὺς ἀπὸ παντὸς μολυσμοῦ σαρκὸς καὶ πνεύματος ἐπιτελοῦντες ἁγιωσύνην ἐν φόβῳ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tautas oun echontes tas epangelias agapētoi katharisōmen heautous apo pantos molysmou sarkos kai pneumatos epitelountes hagiōsynēn en phobō Theou
verses.literal: Therefore beloved since we have these promises let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit perfecting holiness in the fear of God
verses.literalPt: ORA, amados, pois que temos tais promessas, purifiquemo-nos de toda a imundícia da carne e do espírito, aperfeiçoando a santificação no temor de Deus.

verses.original: Χωρήσατε ἡμᾶς οὐδένα ἠδικήσαμεν οὐδένα ἐφθείραμεν οὐδένα ἐπλεονεκτήσαμεν
verses.transliteration: Chōrēsate hēmas oudena ēdikēsamen oudena ephtheiramen oudena epleonektēsamen
verses.literal: Make room for us in your hearts . . . We have wronged no one we have corrupted no one we have exploited no one
verses.literalPt: Recebei-nos em vossos corações; a ninguém agravamos, a ninguém corrompemos, de ninguém buscamos o nosso proveito.

verses.original: πρὸς κατάκρισιν οὐ λέγω προείρηκα γὰρ ὅτι ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν ἐστε εἰς τὸ συναποθανεῖν καὶ συζῆν
verses.transliteration: pros katakrisin ou legō proeirēka gar hoti en tais kardiais hēmōn este eis to synapothanein kai syzēn
verses.literal: I do not say this to condemn you I have said before that you so occupy . . . our hearts that we live and die together with you
verses.literalPt: Não digo isto para vossa condenação; pois já antes tinha dito que estais em nossos corações para juntamente morrer e viver.

verses.original: πολλή μοι παρρησία πρὸς ὑμᾶς πολλή μοι καύχησις ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν πεπλήρωμαι τῇ παρακλήσει ὑπερπερισσεύομαι τῇ χαρᾷ ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ θλίψει ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: pollē moi parrēsia pros hymas pollē moi kauchēsis hyper hymōn peplērōmai tē paraklēsei hyperperisseuomai tē chara epi pasē tē thlipsei hēmōn
verses.literal: Great is my confidence in you great is my pride in you I am filled with encouragement in all our troubles my joy overflows . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Grande é a ousadia da minha fala para convosco, e grande a minha jactância a respeito de vós; estou cheio de consolação; transbordo de gozo em todas as nossas tribulações.

verses.original: Καὶ γὰρ ἐλθόντων ἡμῶν εἰς Μακεδονίαν οὐδεμίαν ἔσχηκεν ἄνεσιν ἡ σὰρξ ἡμῶν ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ θλιβόμενοι ἔξωθεν μάχαι ἔσωθεν φόβοι
verses.transliteration: Kai gar elthontōn hēmōn eis Makedonian oudemian eschēken anesin hē sarx hēmōn all’ en panti thlibomenoi exōthen machai esōthen phoboi
verses.literal: For when we arrived in Macedonia our bodies had no rest but we were pressed from every direction conflicts on the outside fears within
verses.literalPt: Porque, mesmo quando chegamos à Macedônia, a nossa carne não teve repouso algum; antes em tudo fomos atribulados: por fora combates, temores por dentro.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὁ παρακαλῶν τοὺς ταπεινοὺς παρεκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ Τίτου
verses.transliteration: all’ ho parakalōn tous tapeinous parekalesen hēmas ho Theos en tē parousia Titou
verses.literal: But God who comforts the downcast comforted us by the arrival of Titus
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus, que consola os abatidos, nos consolou com a vinda de Tito.

verses.original: οὐ μόνον δὲ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῇ παρακλήσει ᾗ παρεκλήθη ἐφ’ ὑμῖν ἀναγγέλλων ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἐπιπόθησιν τὸν ὑμῶν ὀδυρμόν τὸν ὑμῶν ζῆλον ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ ὥστε με μᾶλλον χαρῆναι
verses.transliteration: ou monon de en tē parousia autou alla kai en tē paraklēsei hē pareklēthē eph’ hymin anangellōn hēmin tēn hymōn epipothēsin ton hymōn odyrmon ton hymōn zēlon hyper emou hōste me mallon charēnai
verses.literal: and not only by his arrival but also by the comfort he had received from you He told us about . . . your longing your mourning and your zeal for me so that I rejoiced all the more
verses.literalPt: E não somente com a sua vinda, mas também pela consolação com que foi consolado por vós, constando-nos as vossas saudades, o vosso choro, o vosso zelo por mim, de maneira que muito me regozijei.

verses.original: Ὅτι εἰ καὶ ἐλύπησα ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ οὐ μεταμέλομαι εἰ καὶ μετεμελόμην βλέπω γὰρ ὅτι ἡ ἐπιστολὴ ἐκείνη εἰ καὶ πρὸς ὥραν ἐλύπησεν ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Hoti ei kai elypēsa hymas en tē epistolē ou metamelomai ei kai metemelomēn blepō gar hoti hē epistolē ekeinē ei kai pros hōran elypēsen hymas
verses.literal: Even if I caused you sorrow . . . by my letter I do not regret it Although . . . I did regret it for I see . . . that my letter caused you sorrow but only . . . for a short time
verses.literalPt: Porquanto, ainda que vos contristei com a minha carta, não me arrependo, embora já me tivesse arrependido por ver que aquela carta vos contristou, ainda que por pouco tempo.

verses.original: νῦν χαίρω οὐχ ὅτι ἐλυπήθητε ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἐλυπήθητε εἰς μετάνοιαν ἐλυπήθητε γὰρ κατὰ Θεόν ἵνα ἐν μηδενὶ ζημιωθῆτε ἐξ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: nyn chairō ouch hoti elypēthēte all’ hoti elypēthēte eis metanoian elypēthēte gar kata Theon hina en mēdeni zēmiōthēte ex hēmōn
verses.literal: yet now I rejoice not because you were made sorrowful but because your sorrow led you to repentance For you felt the sorrow that God had intended . . . and so were not harmed in any way by us
verses.literalPt: Agora folgo, não porque fostes contristados, mas porque fostes contristados para arrependimento; pois fostes contristados segundo Deus; de maneira que por nós não padecestes dano em coisa alguma.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ κατὰ Θεὸν λύπη μετάνοιαν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἀμεταμέλητον ἐργάζεται ἡ δὲ τοῦ κόσμου λύπη θάνατον κατεργάζεται
verses.transliteration: hē gar kata Theon lypē metanoian eis sōtērian ametamelēton ergazetai hē de tou kosmou lypē thanaton katergazetai
verses.literal: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret but worldly sorrow brings death
verses.literalPt: Porque a tristeza segundo Deus opera arrependimento para a salvação, da qual ninguém se arrepende; mas a tristeza do mundo opera a morte.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ γὰρ αὐτὸ τοῦτο τὸ κατὰ Θεὸν λυπηθῆναι πόσην κατειργάσατο ὑμῖν σπουδήν ἀλλὰ ἀπολογίαν ἀλλὰ ἀγανάκτησιν ἀλλὰ φόβον ἀλλὰ ἐπιπόθησιν ἀλλὰ ζῆλον ἀλλὰ ἐκδίκησιν ἐν παντὶ συνεστήσατε ἑαυτοὺς ἁγνοὺς εἶναι τῷ πράγματι
verses.transliteration: Idou gar auto touto to kata Theon lypēthēnai posēn kateirgasato hymin spoudēn alla apologian alla aganaktēsin alla phobon alla epipothēsin alla zēlon alla ekdikēsin en panti synestēsate heautous hagnous einai tō pragmati
verses.literal: Consider what this . . . . . . godly sorrow has produced in you what earnestness what eagerness to clear yourselves what indignation what alarm what longing what zeal what vindication In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter
verses.literalPt: Porque, quanto cuidado não produziu isto mesmo em vós que, segundo Deus, fostes contristados! que apologia, que indignação, que temor, que saudades, que zelo, que vingança! Em tudo mostrastes estar puros neste negócio.

verses.original: ἄρα εἰ καὶ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν οὐχ ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἀδικήσαντος οὐδὲ ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἀδικηθέντος ἀλλ’ ἕνεκεν τοῦ φανερωθῆναι τὴν σπουδὴν ὑμῶν τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ara ei kai egrapsa hymin ouch heneken tou adikēsantos oude heneken tou adikēthentos all’ heneken tou phanerōthēnai tēn spoudēn hymōn tēn hyper hēmōn pros hymas enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: So even though I wrote to you it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed but rather that your earnestness on our behalf . . . would be made clear to you in the sight of God
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ainda que vos escrevi, não foi por causa do que fez o agravo, nem por causa do que sofreu o agravo, mas para que o vosso grande cuidado por nós fosse manifesto diante de Deus.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο παρακεκλήμεθα Ἐπὶ δὲ τῇ παρακλήσει ἡμῶν περισσοτέρως μᾶλλον ἐχάρημεν ἐπὶ τῇ χαρᾷ Τίτου ὅτι ἀναπέπαυται τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: dia touto parakeklēmetha Epi de tē paraklēsei hēmōn perissoterōs mallon echarēmen epi tē chara Titou hoti anapepautai to pneuma autou apo pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: On account of this we are encouraged In addition to our own encouragement we were even more delighted . . . . . . by the joy of Titus For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you
verses.literalPt: Por isso fomos consolados pela vossa consolação, e muito mais nos alegramos pela alegria de Tito, porque o seu espírito foi recreado por vós todos.

verses.original: ὅτι εἴ τι αὐτῷ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν κεκαύχημαι οὐ κατῃσχύνθην ἀλλ’ ὡς πάντα ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ἐλαλήσαμεν ὑμῖν οὕτως καὶ ἡ καύχησις ἡμῶν ἡ ἐπὶ Τίτου ἀλήθεια ἐγενήθη
verses.transliteration: hoti ei ti autō hyper hymōn kekauchēmai ou katēschynthēn all’ hōs panta en alētheia elalēsamen hymin houtōs kai hē kauchēsis hēmōn hē epi Titou alētheia egenēthē
verses.literal: Indeed I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you But just as everything we said to you was true so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well
verses.literalPt: Porque, se nalguma coisa me gloriei de vós para com ele, não fiquei envergonhado; mas, como vos dissemos tudo com verdade, também a nossa glória para com Tito se achou verdadeira.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ περισσοτέρως εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐστιν ἀναμιμνῃσκομένου τὴν πάντων ὑμῶν ὑπακοήν ὡς μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐδέξασθε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai ta splanchna autou perissoterōs eis hymas estin anamimnēskomenou tēn pantōn hymōn hypakoēn hōs meta phobou kai tromou edexasthe auton
verses.literal: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling
verses.literalPt: E o seu entranhável afeto para convosco é mais abundante, lembrando-se da obediência de vós todos, e de como o recebestes com temor e tremor.

verses.original: χαίρω ὅτι ἐν παντὶ θαρρῶ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: chairō hoti en panti tharrō en hymin
verses.literal: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you
verses.literalPt: Regozijo-me de em tudo poder confiar em vós.
